notes: Only amd64 is currently release-qualified as a complete LightNAS control-plane build.
Other architectures are required targets and must not be marked supported until install and boot validation exists.
Native system-container creation must not hard-code amd64 or x86_64.
A zero upload maximum means LightNAS imposes no application-level size ceiling; filesystem capacity and free-space safety remain authoritative.
Installability and release qualification are distinct. Native ARM/RISC-V full runtimes must pass the execution probe.
Bundled Kubernetes is optional and requires 4 GiB total RAM for a server, or 3 GiB for a joined agent.
All architectures target the same full application. There is no reduced-feature compatibility profile. Runtime and Kubernetes build gaps remain unqualified, not feature removals.
